text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing the 7 months in which runs were started. Rule at 0: same correlation as ENS. Five Primary substations metered in MW, daylight half-hours of April to September, 73 forecast runs one every 5 days: July to September 2025 and April to June 2026.'
